cases.notes: 2026-08-29 WS-E honesty pass: the utterance used to say 'the second line' against a one-line A02 fixture (execution_failed: 'no line item matching "second line"'). Investigated both ends of the fix the plan offered: seeding a second line ALONE would not have been enough — estimate-editor.ts's resolveIndexByDescription only ever matches a line item's real description text (exact, then substring); estimate-edit-task.ts's LLM prompt never receives the estimate's current line items at all (grepped — no lineItems/currentLineItems reference in that file) and has no ordinal ('first'/'second'/'third') parsing anywhere in the codebase, so 'the second line' can only ever be echoed back literally and can never resolve, no matter how many real lines exist. Combined both directives instead: A02 now seeds a genuine two-line estimate (real multi-line coverage, per the plan's stated preference), and this utterance names the target line by its actual drafted text ('permit fee') so resolveIndexByDescription's substring match has something real to hit. expectedOutcome stays executes — strengthened, not weakened: this is now provably resolvable where the old wording never was.

cases.notes: 2026-08-29 WS-E honesty pass — first-nudge-free path. FUP-002's 48h cooldown (SendEstimateNudgeExecutionHandler, proposals/execution/handlers.ts) is RATIFIED-correct product behavior, so this row nudging the SAME estimate A18 just sent seconds earlier in the SAME run was never a bug, but it made `executes` unprovable — every run legitimately hit the guard. No longer dependsOn A18: ensureFixtures() now seeds a DEDICATED 'QA Sweep Nudge Fixture' customer (own job + estimate, primary_phone + sms_consent set for the SMS nudge channel) with a 'sent', unanswered estimate whose seed dispatch is 72h old (self-healing across runs, see run-sweep.mjs), so THIS row's first nudge against it is genuinely provable as executes. A dedicated customer — not FIXTURE_CUSTOMER — is required: SendEstimateNudgeTaskHandler resolves the target via a customer-anchored estimate search (voice-extended-tasks.ts), so a second 'sent' estimate on the SAME customer as the A02->A05->A18 chain would be genuine ambiguity (a voice_clarification with no execution handler) regardless of in-run timing, not just a cooldown refusal. Proves FUP-002's 48h cooldown correctly refusing a second nudge on the SAME 'QA Sweep Nudge Fixture' estimate A19 just successfully nudged seconds earlier in this run. Runner change: added expectedOutcome 'guard_pass' (run-sweep.mjs OUTCOME_ENUM + a dedicated scoring branch) because the existing executes/draft_gated scoring always scores ANY execution_failed as PARTIAL — that conflated 'the guard did its job' with 'something actually went wrong', which is exactly the dishonesty this WS-E pass was chartered to remove. guard_pass PASSes only when execution genuinely fails AND the error matches refusalHint; it FAILs outright (not a soft downgrade to PARTIAL) if the guard doesn't fire and the nudge executes instead, so a real regression can never hide behind this label. dependsOn A19 (not the old A18 chain) so this always runs after A19 has actually nudged the SAME estimate, guaranteeing the cooldown is live when this row fires.
